title: Lower Bounds for Nonconvex-Concave Minimax Optimization
summary: We study lower bounds on the first-order oracle complexity of smooth nonconvex-concave minimax optimization. We consider objectives $f$ that are jointly $L$-smooth in the primal and dual variables $(x,y)$, concave in $y$, and whose primal value function $Φ(x) := \max_{y\in\mathcal Y} f(x,y)$ satisfies the initial-gap condition $Φ(0)-\inf_{x\in\mathcal X}Φ(x)\le Δ_Φ$, with a bounded dual domain satisfying $\operatorname{diam}(\mathcal Y)\le D_{\mathcal Y}$.
